description: This file manages rendering effects, frame loop control, and global effect callbacks for a React Three Fiber project, including functions for adding effects, running the render loop, invalidating frames, and advancing frames.

methods.name: createSubs
methods.description: Creates a subscription callback and manages its addition/removal from a set.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes all callbacks in a given set of SubItems with the provided timestamp.

methods.name: flushGlobalEffects
methods.description: Runs all global effects of a specified type ('before', 'after', 'tail') with the given timestamp.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Performs frame update logic, including running effects, rendering roots, and updating internal state.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Main animation loop that manages rendering frames, effects, and stopping conditions.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Requests a new frame to be rendered, optionally for a specific root state.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Manually advances the frame loop, executing effects and updates, useful for 'never' frameloop mode.
